methodologyNotes: Covers handheld electric wood routers used in woodworking: fixed-base, plunge-base, combo kits (both bases), and compact/palm/trim routers. Excludes CNC router machines, stationary router-table-only spindles, rotary tools (Dremel-style), and laminate trimmers without a router collet. Price is typical US MSRP in USD (bare-tool price noted when a model is commonly sold without battery). powerSource is an enum, either 'corded' or 'cordless'. motorPowerHp is peak/max horsepower as published by the maker (for cordless, the maker's stated max-HP-equivalent; null if not published). amperageA is corded input current in amps (null for cordless). voltageV is nominal battery voltage in volts for cordless tools (null for corded). colletSizesIn lists included collet capacities in inches as a string (e.g. '1/4' or '1/4, 1/2'). speedRangeRpm is the no-load speed in RPM as a string: a min-max range for variable-speed models (e.g. '10000-25000') or a single value for single-speed models. variableSpeed is a boolean. softStart is a boolean (electronic soft-start / slow-start). baseType is an enum, one of 'fixed', 'plunge', 'combo', or 'trim'. plungeStrokeIn is maximum plunge travel in inches (null for fixed or trim models with no plunge base). ledLight is a boolean (built-in worklight). weightLbs is bare tool weight in pounds.
